# ParallelLingvo

> ParallelLingvo is a multilingual vocabulary learning application with an initial catalog of 45 learning languages. Learners can choose three or more languages and keep vocabulary, translations, pronunciation, difficult-word review, and progress connected around the same concept.

Canonical public website: https://parallellingvo.app/
Learning application: https://learn.iovenko.eu/
Source repository: https://github.com/ViktorIovenko/Learn_English_and_Dutch

## Learning-language architecture

ParallelLingvo targets 45 launch languages: major European languages plus selected major world languages. The backend uses normalized `word_translations` records rather than adding one database column per language, so the catalog can expand later without redesigning the `words` table.

A learner selects at least three languages. One vocabulary concept can have any number of language forms attached to it.

The application catalog is the source of truth: `app/languages.py`.

Website-interface localization and supported learning languages are separate concerns. Additional website localizations can be added progressively while the learning engine remains language-agnostic.

## Core learning model

Lesson -> vocabulary concept -> 3+ selected language forms -> examples/pronunciation -> learning status.

## Multilingual API

- `GET /api/languages` — launch language catalog.
- `GET /api/user_languages` — current learner language selection.
- `PUT /api/user_languages` — save three or more selected languages.
- `GET /api/words/<word_id>/translations` — normalized translations for a word.
- `PUT /api/words/<word_id>/translations` — create/update translations without adding database columns.

Legacy NL/EN/RU fields remain temporarily for backward compatibility during migration.
